tools.name: RunAppTests
tools.description: Replay explicitly selected recording UUIDs for the app being edited. Set all=true only for an intentional full regression run; omitted selection is an error. Reserved suite __platform_smoke__ provides limited visibility/runtime-error coverage only. Poll GetAppTestRun.

project.description: Explicit current app project id. Never use the toolbox id or a different app.

suite.description: Single recording UUID, or __platform_smoke__ for a limited visibility check. Names are not accepted. Mutually exclusive with recordingIds and all=true.

pages.description: Optional additional exact recording-name/startPath filter within the explicit selection. Does not select tests by itself.

repeat.description: Optional 1 to 5. Replays each recording this many times in fresh browsers; it passes only if every replay passes, and differing results are reported FLAKY.

recordingIds.description: Relevant recording UUIDs from ListAppTestRecordings for this app; mutually exclusive with suite and all=true.

all.description: Set true only for an intentional full regression run of this app; mutually exclusive with recordingIds and suite. No selection never means all.

outputSchema.description: runId, explicit target, status and maxFixAttempts

tools.name: GetAppTestRun
tools.description: Read a caller-owned run. RUNNING, COMPLETED, ERROR or NO_TESTS. Check counts/classifications; action-only recordings are SKIPPED/NO_ASSERTIONS. scope PAGE_VISIBILITY_SMOKE verifies page visibility only and provides no saved workflow coverage; always report this limited scope.

outputSchema.description: Caller-owned report with target, status, summary, tests and optional reason/evidence

tools.name: ListAppTestRecordings
tools.description: Discover tests for the app being edited. Returns only id, name and description per recording; no steps, selectors or values. Use GetAppTestRecording to read one relevant definition only when needed.

tools.name: GetAppTestRecording
tools.description: Read one complete test definition by UUID for the app being edited. Call only when its steps/expectations are needed; running selected IDs does not require reading their definitions first.

project.description: Explicit current app project id, never toolbox id.

outputSchema.description: Explicit target and one complete recording definition

tools.name: SaveAppTestRecording
tools.description: Save a recorded workflow with optional assertions. Do not change tests merely to hide app failures.

recording.description: Version 1 recording with required name, description and steps; optional id and app-relative startPath.

description.description: Explain the workflow and expected outcome this test verifies.

items.description: Declarative action/assertion. Optional pagePath is the app-relative top-level URL expected before the step; replay waits for it, including query/hash routes.

outputSchema.description: Saved id, version, name, description, startPath, steps, updatedAt

tools.name: DeleteAppTestRecording
tools.description: Delete a recording only when explicitly requested; never remove tests to make a run pass.
